summary: 22 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • secondary-profession-catalog: add secondary profession catalog runtime system (b3125d4)
  • misc: add diagnostics and test coverage (57f2ac0)
  • chat-images: add Chat Images support for session messages (60dbfda)
  • templates: add Agent and Character Templates API (a25e732)
  • gemini: add Gemini CLI Provider integration (9839cb5)
  • opencode: add OpenCode Runtime integration support (43bd1f5)
  • image-storage: add Image Storage Management feature (f1a6875)
  • git: add discard, push, and pull operations for Git repositories (6a76958)
  • orleans: add centralized Orleans timeout policy configuration (174e22b)
  • trait-marketplace: add Trait Marketplace feature (43049a1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • utils: add localizeHeroTag for i18n tag label resolution (965045c)
  • statusbar: add Gemini AI icon and improve status display (0a8ba0a)
  • proposal: add image upload support and enhanced proposal creation (4921e9b)
  • chat: add attachment support and recent history context menu (d305b47)
  • session: add archive sync and recent conversation history (e66b25c)
  • data: add image storage management components and store (5ff603b)
  • git: add rebase dialog and remote sync operations (c4f0b03)
  • hero: add agent and character template integration (75b6fd0)
  • kanban: add repository table with sync status to quick actions dropdown (61d9bc3)
  • git: add file context menu, push/pull buttons, and remote sync UI (bde32da)
  • git: add repository sync utilities and push/pull/discard operations (520adff)
  • ui: add window event types and update component styling (819b67c)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: fix loading state and soul editor logic (e86bbfc)
